subject: Invest in Medford Ballot Questions
overview: Elected officials hosted a virtual community forum to present and answer resident questions regarding ballot questions six, seven, and eight, which propose property tax overrides and a debt exclusion for Medford schools, street repairs, and a new fire headquarters.

items.title: Overview of Ballot Questions 6, 7, and 8
items.summary: Zac Bears, Jenny Graham, and Paul Ruseau presented an overview of ballot questions six, seven, and eight proposing property tax overrides and a debt exclusion to fund schools, street repairs, and a new fire headquarters.

items.title: Potential School Budget Cuts Without Overrides
items.summary: Panelists detailed potential staff layoffs and program cuts across the school district if the override ballot questions fail.

items.title: Proposed School Improvements Under Question 8
items.summary: Panelists discussed potential investments funded by Question 8, including living wages for staff, vocational school schedule integration, and expanded instructional time.

items.title: Long-Term Revenue Planning and High School Project
items.summary: Panelists outlined long-term city financial strategies, zoning reforms, and the multi-year process required for a future Medford High School building project.

items.title: District Administrative Staffing
items.summary: Paul Ruseau addressed questions regarding district leadership, stating that central office operations are understaffed rather than top-heavy.

items.title: Override Campaign Strategy and Staff Retention
items.summary: Panelists explained the rationale for placing the overrides on the ballot and discussed how municipal understaffing drives employee turnover.

items.title: Residential Property Tax Exemption Discussion
items.summary: Zac Bears outlined the mechanics, administrative requirements, and tax-shift implications of an owner-occupied property tax exemption.

items.title: High School Vocational Schedule Integration
items.summary: Jenny Graham detailed the administrative timeline and union negotiations necessary to align academic and vocational schedules for the upcoming school year.

items.title: Override Fund Usage and Allocation Rules
items.summary: Zac Bears and Jenny Graham clarified statutory requirements governing override funds and affirmed long-term municipal commitments to school funding.

items.title: Forum Wrap-Up and Campaign Resources
items.summary: Organizers provided information on upcoming public forums, campaign resources, and key voting deadlines leading up to Election Day.
